name: Kitsune Trickster
summary: (Kitsune Only) The kitsune trickster combines her sharpened wit with minor arcane powers of charm and persuasion.

features.name: Kitsune’s Guile (Ex)
features.summary: At 1st level, a trickster relies on her intellect as much as her personality. She adds her Intelligence modifier on Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, and Sense Motive checks. This ability replaces trapfinding.

features.name: Kitsune’s Charm (Sp)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a kitsune trickster can use charm person once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to her rogue level – 2). At 6th level, and every three levels thereafter, the kitsune trickster gains an additional daily use of this ability. This ability replaces trap sense.

features.name: Rogue Talents
features.summary: The following rogue talents complement the kitsune trickster archetype: major magic, minor magic ( Core Rulebook ); false friend, obfuscate story, steal the story (see below); charmer, coax information, honeyed words ; convincing lie.

features.name: Advanced Talents
features.summary: The following advanced rogue talents complement the kitsune trickster archetype: skill mastery, slippery mind ( Core Rulebook ); master of disguise ; rumormonger.
